import Mathlib

structure MaxMatchingGraph where
  left_size : Nat
  right_size : Nat
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def MaxMatchingGraph.well_formed (g : MaxMatchingGraph) : Prop :=
  g.adj.size = g.left_size ∧
  ∀ u, u < g.left_size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.right_size

def MaxMatchingGraph.has_edge (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.left_size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

-- Matching definition
structure Matching where
  edges : List (Nat × Nat)

def Matching.is_valid (m : Matching) (g : MaxMatchingGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ e, e ∈ m.edges → g.has_edge e.1 e.2

def Matching.is_disjoint (m : Matching) : Prop :=
  ∀ e1 e2, e1 ∈ m.edges → e2 ∈ m.edges → e1 ≠ e2 →
    e1.1 ≠ e2.1 ∧ e1.2 ≠ e2.2

def Matching.size (m : Matching) : Nat :=
  m.edges.length

def is_matching (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (m : Matching) : Prop :=
  m.is_valid g ∧ 
  m.is_disjoint ∧
  m.edges.Nodup

def is_max_matching_size (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ m, is_matching g m ∧ m.size = k) ∧
  (∀ m, is_matching g m → m.size ≤ k)

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def max_bipartite_matching_precond (graph : MaxMatchingGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧ graph.left_size ≤ 1000 ∧ graph.right_size ≤ 1000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
noncomputable section

theorem list_toFinset_card_eq_length_of_nodup {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] :
    ∀ (l : List α), l.Nodup → l.toFinset.card = l.length
  | [], _ => by
      simp
  | a :: t, h => by
      cases h with
      | cons hrel ht =>
          have ha : a ∉ t := by
            intro hin
            exact (hrel a hin) rfl
          have ih := list_toFinset_card_eq_length_of_nodup t ht
          have haFin : a ∉ t.toFinset := by
            simpa using ha
          simp [haFin, ih]

theorem exists_max_nat_of_bounded (P : Nat → Prop) (B : Nat)
    (h0 : P 0) (hbound : ∀ k, P k → k ≤ B) :
    ∃ k, P k ∧ ∀ n, P n → n ≤ k := by
  revert hbound
  induction B with
  | zero =>
      intro hbound
      refine ⟨0, h0, ?_⟩
      intro n hn
      exact hbound n hn
  | succ B ih =>
      intro hbound
      classical
      by_cases htop : P (B + 1)
      · refine ⟨B + 1, htop, ?_⟩
        intro n hn
        simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hbound n hn
      · have hboundB : ∀ k, P k → k ≤ B := by
          intro k hk
          have hle : k ≤ B + 1 := by
            simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hbound k hk
          have hne : k ≠ B + 1 := by
            intro hkEq
            apply htop
            simpa [hkEq] using hk
          omega
        exact ih hboundB

theorem matching_size_le_mul (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (m : Matching) (hm : is_matching g m) :
    m.size ≤ g.left_size * g.right_size := by
  classical
  let S : Finset (Nat × Nat) :=
    (Finset.range g.left_size).product (Finset.range g.right_size)
  have hsubset : m.edges.toFinset ⊆ S := by
    intro e he
    have hemem : e ∈ m.edges := by
      simpa using he
    have hedge : g.has_edge e.1 e.2 := hm.1 e hemem
    have hu : e.1 < g.left_size := hedge.1
    have hv : e.2 < g.right_size := hwf.2 e.1 hu e.2 hedge.2
    simp [S, Finset.mem_product, hu, hv]
  have hcard : m.edges.toFinset.card ≤ S.card := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
  have hnodup : m.edges.Nodup := hm.2.2
  have hcard_edges : m.edges.toFinset.card = m.edges.length :=
    list_toFinset_card_eq_length_of_nodup m.edges hnodup
  have hcardS : S.card = g.left_size * g.right_size := by
    simp [S]
  calc
    m.size = m.edges.length := rfl
    _ = m.edges.toFinset.card := by rw [hcard_edges]
    _ ≤ S.card := hcard
    _ = g.left_size * g.right_size := hcardS

theorem exists_is_max_matching_size (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∃ k, is_max_matching_size g k := by
  let P : Nat → Prop := fun k => ∃ m, is_matching g m ∧ m.size = k
  have h0 : P 0 := by
    refine ⟨{ edges := [] }, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [is_matching, Matching.is_valid, Matching.is_disjoint]
    · rfl
  have hbound : ∀ k, P k → k ≤ g.left_size * g.right_size := by
    intro k hk
    rcases hk with ⟨m, hm, hsize⟩
    rw [← hsize]
    exact matching_size_le_mul g hwf m hm
  rcases exists_max_nat_of_bounded P (g.left_size * g.right_size) h0 hbound with
    ⟨k, hk, hmax⟩
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · exact hk
  · intro m hm
    exact hmax m.size ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def max_bipartite_matching (graph : MaxMatchingGraph)
    (h_precond : max_bipartite_matching_precond graph) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  Classical.choose (exists_is_max_matching_size graph h_precond.1)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def max_bipartite_matching_postcond (graph : MaxMatchingGraph) (result : Nat)
    (_ : max_bipartite_matching_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_max_matching_size graph result
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem max_bipartite_matching_postcond_satisfied (graph : MaxMatchingGraph)
    (h_precond : max_bipartite_matching_precond graph) :
    max_bipartite_matching_postcond graph
      (max_bipartite_matching graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  exact Classical.choose_spec (exists_is_max_matching_size graph h_precond.1)
  -- !benchmark @end proof

theorem exists_is_max_matching_size (g : MaxMatchingGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∃ k, is_max_matching_size g k := by
  let P : Nat → Prop := fun k => ∃ m, is_matching g m ∧ m.size = k
  have h0 : P 0 := by
    refine ⟨{ edges := [] }, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [is_matching, Matching.is_valid, Matching.is_disjoint]
    · rfl
  have hbound : ∀ k, P k → k ≤ g.left_size * g.right_size := by
    intro k hk
    rcases hk with ⟨m, hm, hsize⟩
    rw [← hsize]
    exact matching_size_le_mul g hwf m hm
  rcases exists_max_nat_of_bounded P (g.left_size * g.right_size) h0 hbound with
    ⟨k, hk, hmax⟩
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · exact hk
  · intro m hm
    exact hmax m.size ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
